description: This file contains SQLAlchemy ORM model definitions for the Superset project, including models for databases, themes, key-value stores, OAuth2 tokens, logs, and favorites, along with associated methods for database connection management, schema inspection, and OAuth2 handling.

classes.name: KeyValue
classes.description: A key-value store model for generic key-value data storage.

classes.name: CssTemplate
classes.description: Model for storing CSS templates for dashboards.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Model representing themes for dashboards, including theme name and JSON data.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Core ORM model for database connection info, with methods for connection management, schema inspection, OAuth2 handling, and SQL execution.

classes.name: DatabaseUserOAuth2Tokens
classes.description: Model for storing OAuth2 tokens associated with users for database authentication.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Model for logging user actions within Superset.

methods.name: get_sqla_engine
methods.description: Context manager that yields a SQLAlchemy engine, establishing SSH tunnels if configured.

methods.name: get_raw_connection
methods.description: Context manager that yields a raw database connection, executing pre-session queries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Synchronously executes a SQL query using SQLExecutor.

methods.name: execute_async
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a SQL query via Celery.

methods.name: load_into_dataframe
methods.description: Converts query results into a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: get_table
methods.description: Retrieves a SQLAlchemy Table object for a given table.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a table.

methods.name: get_indexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a table.

methods.name: get_pk_constraint
methods.description: Retrieves primary key constraints for a table.

methods.name: get_foreign_keys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a table.

methods.name: get_schema_access_for_file_upload
methods.description: Returns schemas allowed for file upload, considering user permissions.
